name: recall_memory
title: recall_memory
description: Read previously stored project notes (conventions, failures, decisions). Call early in a session when you need prior context beyond the scene tree. Newest matching entries are returned first.

category.description: If set, only return notes with this category.

query.description: If set, only return notes whose text contains this substring (case-insensitive).

limit.description: Maximum number of notes to return.
